title: Crop Insurance Underwriting Guide: Unit Structures and Production History
content:
Under Crop Insurance the unit structures a member may elect, the planting needed for enterprise units and the treatment of a member's actual production history (APH) are set by plan and coverage level.

| Plan and coverage level | Unit structures that may be elected | Sections required for enterprise units | One policy record per crop, county and crop year | Years of APH before transitional yields stop being used | Yield substitution | Trend-adjusted APH endorsement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) | basic | 0 (not available) | Yes | 4 | No | No |
| Revenue Protection 65% Coverage | basic, optional, enterprise | 2 | Yes | 4 | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 70% Coverage | basic, optional, enterprise | 2 | Yes | 4 | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 75% Coverage | basic, optional, enterprise | 2 | Yes | 4 | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 80% Coverage | basic, optional, enterprise | 2 | Yes | 4 | Yes | Yes |
| Revenue Protection 85% Coverage | basic, optional, enterprise | 2 | Yes | 4 | Yes | Yes |

Definitions, as the product states them:

- **Unit structures** — Unit structures that may be elected.
- **Sections required for enterprise units** — Sections in which the crop must be planted to qualify for enterprise units; a figure of 0 means not available.
- **One policy record** — whether a member holds one policy record per crop, county and crop year.
- **Years of APH** — Years of actual production history needed before transitional yields stop being used.
- **Yield substitution** — whether low yields in the APH may be replaced by 60% of the transitional yield.
- **Trend-adjusted APH endorsement** — whether the trend-adjusted APH endorsement may be elected.

## Points of judgement

**Enterprise units at the catastrophic level.** Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) lists basic units only, and its enterprise-unit section figure is 0, which marks enterprise units as not available at that level.

**Enterprise units at a Revenue Protection level.** Enterprise units may be elected at any Revenue Protection level when the crop is planted in at least 2 sections. A crop planted in 2 sections meets that figure; a crop planted in a single section does not.

**A member with three years of production history.** Transitional yields stop being used only once 4 years of actual production history exist, so with three years on record transitional yields are still being used, at every level.

**Replacing a low year.** At any Revenue Protection level a low yield in the APH may be replaced by 60% of the transitional yield, and the trend-adjusted APH endorsement may be elected. At Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) neither switch is on.
